tools.name: convert_cooking_measure
tools.rich: Convert an amount of one named cooking ingredient from one measure to another, for example between two weight units or between a weight and a volume. Not for spoon and cup conversions that do not depend on the ingredient.

params.name: quantity
params.rich: How many of the starting unit there are, as a whole number.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the quantity is in, such as cup.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to, such as gram.

params.name: item
params.rich: The ingredient being converted, such as flour.

tools.name: convert_recipe_unit
tools.rich: Convert a number of kitchen volume measures, such as spoons and cups, into another kitchen volume measure. The result does not depend on the ingredient. Not for weights and not for turning a named ingredient from weight into volume.

params.name: value
params.rich: How many of the starting unit there are, as a whole number.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The kitchen unit the value is in, such as cup.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The kitchen unit to convert to.

params.name: precision
params.rich: How many decimal places to round to when the result is not a whole number. 1 when omitted.

tools.name: convert_timezone
tools.rich: Change a clock time from one time zone to another, using the current offsets of both zones. Not for a time on a particular past or future date, whose offset may differ, and not for the time right now.

params.name: time
params.rich: The local time you want to convert, e.g. 3pm

params.name: from_timezone
params.rich: The time zone the time is in, named by a city or a zone name.

params.name: to_timezone
params.rich: The time zone to convert to, named the same way.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.rich: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another at the current market exchange rate. Not for the rate that is published once a day and not for facts about a currency.

params.name: base_currency
params.rich: The currency the amount is in, written as its three-letter code, such as GBP.

params.name: target_currency
params.rich: The currency to convert to, written the same way.

params.name: amount
params.rich: The amount to convert, as a whole number.

tools.name: convert_currency_at_reference_rate
tools.rich: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another at a rate published once a day. Not for the live market rate and not for facts about a currency.

params.name: amount
params.rich: The amount to convert, as a whole number.

params.name: from_currency
params.rich: The currency the amount is in, written as its three-letter code, such as CHF.

params.name: to_currency
params.rich: The currency to convert to, written the same way.

tools.name: convert_length
tools.rich: Convert a distance or length between metric and imperial units. Not for the distance between two places.

params.name: value
params.rich: The number of the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_mass
tools.rich: Convert a mass or weight between metric and imperial units. Not for measuring an ingredient by volume.

params.name: value
params.rich: The number of the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_temperature
tools.rich: Convert a temperature reading from one scale to another. Not for the weather outside.

params.name: value
params.rich: The temperature on the starting scale.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_area
tools.rich: Convert a surface area between metric and imperial units. Not for lengths and not for volumes.

params.name: value
params.rich: The number of the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_speed
tools.rich: Convert a speed between units used on roads, at sea and in science. Not for the time a trip takes.

params.name: value
params.rich: The speed in the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_volume
tools.rich: Convert a liquid or container volume between metric and imperial units. Not for kitchen spoon and cup measures.

params.name: value
params.rich: The number of the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_data_size
tools.rich: Convert an amount of digital data between units, counting each step as a thousand of the one below. Not for a transfer speed.

params.name: value
params.rich: The size in the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_energy
tools.rich: Convert an amount of energy between units, including food energy and electricity use. Not for temperatures and not for power.

params.name: value
params.rich: The energy in the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: convert_duration
tools.rich: Convert a length of time between units such as hours and days. Not for a clock time in another time zone.

params.name: value
params.rich: The length of time in the starting unit.

params.name: from_unit
params.rich: The unit the value is in.

params.name: to_unit
params.rich: The unit to convert to.

tools.name: get_local_time
tools.rich: The current date and time in one city or time zone, as it is right now. Not for turning a given clock time into another zone.

params.name: place
params.rich: The city or time zone to look up.

tools.name: get_currency_info
tools.rich: The name, symbol, issuing country and number of decimal places of one currency. Not for turning an amount into another currency.

params.name: currency
params.rich: The currency, written as its three-letter code, such as GBP.

tools.name: describe_unit
tools.rich: What a unit of measurement is, what it measures and how it relates to the base unit of its system. Not for turning a number from one unit into another.

params.name: unit
params.rich: The unit to explain, such as a stone.
